## Summary

What this PR changes and why. One or two sentences, from the user's perspective.

## Related issues

- `Closes #n` — if this PR fixes an issue
- `Part of #n` — if this PR advances a ticket
- Blocked by `#n` — if this PR depends on an unmerged change

## Verification

- [ ] `just check` passes
- [ ] `just test` passes
- [ ] `just fmt` is clean
- [ ] Wire surface unchanged, or `docs/API.md` updated to match

## Labels

Apply `area:*` (and `priority:*` if this is time-sensitive). Add `queries` if this touches per-language `.scm` query files.
